presentation_title: The Anatomy of a Good Prompt: The 3 Cs
learning_objectives: Identify the three key ingredients of effective prompts: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Explain how Clarity improves AI outputs by making requests specific.
Describe how Context helps AI adopt the correct perspective and audience.
Demonstrate how Constraints shape AI outputs by defining rules like length and style.
Apply the 3 Cs to transform vague prompts into highly effective ones.
Understand the concept of persona and 'shot prompting' (Zero, One, Few-Shot) to further guide AI.

Basic understanding of Generative AI concepts.
A weak prompt often gives a weak answer.
A great prompt delivers a smart answer.
narration: Familiarity with prompting is helpful.
Our previous 'Introduction to Prompting' tutorial is recommended.
A weak prompt gives a weak answer, while a great prompt delivers a smart one.

slides.title: Introducing the 3 Cs
content: The 3 Cs: Clarity, Context, Constraints.
narration: The best prompts include three key ingredients.
These are Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Mastering them improves your AI interactions.
slides.image_prompt: Graphic with three interconnected circles labeled 'Clarity', 'Context', and 'Constraints', forming a triangle. A central text reads 'Great Prompt'.

slides.title: C1: Clarity - Be Specific!
content: AI doesn't know what you're thinking.
Vague prompts lead to generic, unhelpful answers.
Provide precise instructions for better outcomes.
narration: The first C is Clarity. Be specific!
AI cannot read your mind, so avoid vague requests.
Precise instructions lead to desired outputs.
slides.image_prompt: A magnifying glass focusing on the word 'Specific'. A confused chatbot icon. Text: 'Be Specific!'.

slides.title: Clarity: Analogy and Vague Prompt Example
content: Analogy: Telling a child to 'clean your room'.
They might just hide things without specific tasks.
Vague Prompt: "Write about electric cars."
This prompt is too broad.
The AI doesn't know what aspects to focus on.
narration: Telling a child to 'clean your room' is vague.
They might just hide things, without specific tasks.
Likewise, 'Write about electric cars' is too broad for AI.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon image of a messy room and a child looking confused. Screen close-up: A user typing 'Write about electric cars' into an AI chatbot interface, with a chatbot's response area showing generic, unorganized text about electric cars.

slides.title: Clarity: A Clearer Prompt
content: Clear Prompt: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
The task is 'Write a short blog post'.
The topic is 'top 3 benefits of owning an electric car'.
The target audience is 'someone living in a city'.
narration: Here is a much clearer prompt.
It specifies a 'short blog post' on 'top 3 benefits' of an EV.
The target is 'someone living in a city', giving AI clear guidance.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison of a vague output (generic text) and a focused, short blog post snippet listing 3 benefits of owning an EV in a city. Highlighted phrases in the clear prompt text: 'short blog post', 'top 3 benefits', 'electric car', 'someone living in a city'.

slides.title: C2: Context - Give Background!
content: Context tells the AI why you're asking.
It defines the audience and purpose.
Helps the AI adopt the right perspective and tone.
narration: The second C is Context.
Context tells the AI your purpose and target audience.
This helps the AI adopt the correct perspective and tone.
slides.image_prompt: Visuals of different audience types (e.g., student, professional, lifestyle blogger) surrounding a central AI icon, each indicating a different 'lens' or perspective. An AI icon with multiple thought bubbles showing different tones (e.g., formal, friendly, technical).

slides.title: Context: Analogy and Refined Prompt
content: Analogy: An actor receiving a script.
They need to know the play's genre and character to perform correctly.
Better Prompt (with Context): "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
The blog focuses on sustainable living.
The AI now understands the blog's theme and tailors the content.
narration: Like an actor needing script context to perform correctly,
We add 'for a lifestyle blog on sustainable living'.
The AI now understands the theme and tailors the content.
slides.image_prompt: An actor on a stage, holding a script. Screen close-up: User modifying the 'Clear Prompt' in an AI chatbot, adding the phrase 'for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living' highlighted. A blog layout with a green, sustainable living theme, highlighting where the AI's output would fit.

slides.title: Context: Output Refinement
content: Comparing the 'Clear' output with the 'Better' output.
Adding context tailors the response to a specific niche.
It focuses on sustainable living, using relevant language.
narration: Observe the refined output now.
The response is tailored for sustainable living.
Context makes the output more relevant and targeted.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison. Left: 'Clear' blog post snippet (general benefits). Right: 'Better' blog post snippet with benefits framed within a sustainable living context. A magnifying glass highlighting specific, eco-friendly keywords in the 'Better' prompt output.

slides.title: C3: Constraints - Set the Rules!
content: Constraints are boundaries that shape the output.
Define length, format, or style.
Ensure the AI's response meets your specific requirements.
narration: The third C is Constraints.
These are rules or boundaries for the AI's response.
Define length, format, and style to guide the output.
slides.image_prompt: Icons representing a clock (for length/time), a document outline (for format), and a paintbrush (for style), indicating limitations or guidelines. Text: 'Set the Rules!'.

slides.title: Constraints: Analogy and Excellent Prompt Example
content: Analogy: Following a recipe.
It tells you ingredients, cooking time, and temperature.
These rules ensure the desired dish.

Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): "Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments."
The tone should be friendly and enthusiastic.
The post must end with a question to encourage comments.
narration: Constraints are like a recipe, guiding the final product.
Our excellent prompt adds 'under 400 words' and a specific tone.
It also requires ending with a question to encourage comments.
slides.image_prompt: A chef's hand following a recipe book. Screen close-up: User modifying the 'Better Prompt', adding highlighted text for 'under 400 words', 'friendly and enthusiastic tone', and 'end with a question to encourage comments'.

slides.title: The 3 Cs: Progressive Improvement
content: Each 'C' progressively refines the AI's response.
Clarity, Context, and Constraints help.
The output becomes more specific and polished.
narration: Observe the progressive improvement.
We moved from vague to excellent prompts.
Each added C refines the AI's response, making it polished.
slides.image_prompt: Four distinct text boxes displayed side-by-side or in a grid: 'Vague Output', 'Clear Output', 'Better Output', 'Excellent Output', with clear labels and brief examples of each. An arrow showing progression from a blurred image to a sharp, clear image, symbolizing refinement.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Assign a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to be to get targeted responses.
Analogy: Hiring an Italian chef who uses specific expertise.
Example: "Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food."
narration: A bonus tip: assign a persona to the AI.
Tell it who to be, like an expert travel agent.
This ensures responses reflect specific expertise.
slides.image_prompt: An AI chatbot icon wearing various 'hats' (e.g., chef's hat, doctor's coat, travel agent's tie) to illustrate different personas. A chef in a kitchen preparing an Italian dish. A travel agent's desk displaying a detailed Rome itinerary.

slides.title: Guiding with Examples: Shot Prompting
content: Sometimes, showing is better than telling.
This technique is called 'shot prompting'.
It involves showing the AI the desired pattern.
Methods include Zero-Shot, One-Shot, and Few-Shot.
narration: Guide the AI with examples using 'shot prompting'.
Zero-shot is direct; one-shot provides a single example.
Few-shot uses multiple examples for complex patterns.
slides.image_prompt: A visual metaphor of a teacher demonstrating an action (e.g., drawing a shape) and a student mimicking it, emphasizing 'show, don't just tell'. Combined visuals for Zero-Shot, One-Shot, and Few-Shot prompting, depicting direct input, single example input/output, and multiple example input/output respectively.

slides.title: Summary: Key Prompting Techniques
content: Clarity: Be specific with your instructions.
Context: Give background and purpose.
Constraints: Set rules for length, format, and style.
Persona: Assign a role for targeted output.
Shot Prompting: Guide with examples (Zero, One, Few-Shot).
narration: Master AI prompts using the 3 Cs: Clarity, Context, Constraints.
Assign a persona for tailored responses.
Use shot prompting with examples for precise results.
slides.image_prompt: A visually appealing infographic summarizing the 3 Cs, Persona, and Shot Prompting with small, memorable icons for each point.

slides.title: Assignment: Practice the 3 Cs
content: 1. Pick a simple topic (e.g., Sports, Dogs, Healthy Food).
2. Write a vague prompt about it.
3. Improve it by adding Clarity, then Context, then Constraints.
4. Compare the AI responses at each step. Note the differences.
narration: Practice the 3 Cs with this assignment.
Choose a simple topic and create a vague prompt.
Improve it by adding Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
